title: Amplitude-dependent quantum hydrodynamics from a \(\coth\)-Madelung ansatz
summary: We investigate a nonlinear extension of the Madelung transformation based on a hyperbolic phase--amplitude coupling of the form \[ Ψ= R e^{\imathθ\coth R}, \] where \(R\) is a real amplitude field and \(θ\) is an auxiliary phase coordinate governed by Schrödinger's equation. In contrast to the conventional polar decomposition, this construction imposes a singular hyperbolic relation between amplitude and phase, thereby endowing the Bohmian or hydrodynamic description with an intrinsically geometric structure.
